terms.grammar: gerō with mōrem and the dative of the person
evidence: Ter. Ad. 3.3.77: ut homō est, ita mōrem gerās (Lewis & Short), s.v. homō
Plaut. Asin. 40: Fīat, gerātur mōs tibi.
terms.comment: “To carry out someone’s wish”; the passive gives the reply: gerātur mōs tibi, have it your way.

phrases.english: All right, have it your way.

sources: Lewis & Short: mos · Lewis & Short: gero
